HISTORICAL ASSET INVENTORY — NOT INCLUDED ASSET FILES

asset-manifest.json records names, sizes and SHA-256 values of 1,314 files in
the original local Content tree. It is retained as provenance. It is not a
download manifest, a promise that those assets are included, or a verified
asset snapshot for every experiment. All private-project-assets archives are
excluded from this distribution, including their mixed Poly Haven content.

Retained project/template Content files can refer to excluded dependencies.
For scene reconstruction, obtain assets directly under their own terms:
European Beech: https://www.fab.com/listings/d11cc01d-9422-41b7-950f-416c9ce79caf
Saplings: https://www.fab.com/listings/6867d008-fc3a-404e-9e53-087eccdcd722
Niagara Examples: https://www.fab.com/listings/0e188eca-4e54-4fb2-a9ed-d8b8a565e600
Vefects: https://www.fab.com/listings/d2136c01-8d35-403f-a637-146e8173bdb3
Forest Floor: https://www.fab.com/listings/dae56d09-862c-4f77-9e72-a41281c49633
Poly Haven: https://polyhaven.com/

Third-party character assets are not supplied. Separately acquired assets must
be licensed for the intended use; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Replacing visual
assets changes the rendering configuration and cannot establish exact visual
reproduction.
